posts.title: Winter Sunshine and a €6.50 Breakfast in Los Cristianos
posts.description: Join me for a Wednesday morning wander around Los Cristianos, enjoying the Tenerife sunshine, exploring the seafront, discovering breakfast bargains and learning a little Bulgarian along the way.

posts.title: Freaky Friday with Tim, Webby and the Heavyweights — Friendship, Football and a Few Beers!
posts.description: Another lively Freaky Friday from Nebula in Tenerife, as Tim and Webby welcome Mark, Daz and Nigel for football banter, remarkable stories of friendship, some welcome health news and plenty of laughs.

posts.title: Friday Coffee in Alcalá: A Coastal Walk with Mark and Daz
posts.description: A Friday morning in Alcalá with Mark and Daz: sea views, stories from Wrexham, an unexpected marathon pub stop and a return to the square for coffee.
